preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.
m is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The size k of the found beautiful set matches the number of points printed.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All x-coordinates of the points are within the range [0, n].

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= y <= m for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All y-coordinates of the points are within the range [0, m].

postconditions.expression: all(x + y > 0 for x, y in points)
postconditions.description: All points satisfy the condition x + y > 0.

postconditions.expression: all(not (x1 == x2 and y1 == y2) for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in combinations(points, 2))
postconditions.description: All points in the set are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(not (is_integer_distance((x1, y1), (x2, y2))) for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in combinations(points, 2))
postconditions.description: For any two points in the set, the distance between them is a non-integer.
